name: Project 0

requiredConfig.name: @0dotxyz/p0-ts-sdk optional dependency
requiredConfig.description: Required for Project 0 account health, prepared transaction helpers, account creation, deposit, withdraw, borrow, and repay.

requiredConfig.name: connectors.project0.minHealthRatio
requiredConfig.description: Minimum projected health ratio for borrow and withdraw previews. Defaults to 1.1.

requiredConfig.name: PROJECT0_API_BASE_URL or P0_API_BASE_URL
requiredConfig.description: Optional override for Project 0 bank, strategy, and wallet metadata reads. Defaults to https://ai.0.xyz.

readCapabilities.returns: Project 0 banks with token, mint, venue, deposit APY, borrow APY, USD price, and token program metadata.
Project 0 strategy metadata including primary and secondary banks, spread, leverage, APY, and capacity.
Project 0 wallet holdings and token balances for the selected wallet.
One Project 0 account with supplied and borrowed positions plus account health.
Projected Project 0 account health after deposit, withdraw, borrow, or repay without signing.
Normalized Project 0 facts for markets, strategies, positions, borrow, withdraw, repay, and earn prompts.

writeCapabilities.prepares: A manual-approval inbox item that creates a Project 0 account.
writeCapabilities.userApproves: A Project 0 account creation transaction built from the Project 0 SDK.

writeCapabilities.prepares: A manual-approval inbox item that deposits tokens into a Project 0 bank.
writeCapabilities.userApproves: A Project 0 deposit transaction built from the Project 0 SDK.

writeCapabilities.prepares: A manual-approval inbox item that withdraws supplied tokens after projected health is checked.
writeCapabilities.userApproves: A Project 0 withdraw transaction built from refreshed account and bank state.

writeCapabilities.prepares: A manual-approval inbox item that borrows tokens only when projected health remains above policy.
writeCapabilities.userApproves: A Project 0 borrow transaction built from refreshed account and bank state.

writeCapabilities.prepares: A manual-approval inbox item that repays Project 0 debt for a selected bank.
writeCapabilities.userApproves: A Project 0 repay transaction built from the Project 0 SDK.

requiredUserInputs.prompt: Which Project 0 token or bank should I use?

requiredUserInputs.name: project0Account
requiredUserInputs.prompt: Which Project 0 account should I use?

requiredConnectorFacts: Project 0 account address when the wallet has multiple accounts
Account health before and after borrow or withdraw
Wallet balance and outstanding debt for repay or withdraw-all requests
unsupportedRequests: Borrow or withdraw when the projected health preview is blocked.
Borrow or withdraw without account health facts.
Create delegated authority, recurring automation, or unlimited approvals.
Use liquidation, flash loan, repay-with-collateral, delegated account, or authority-transfer flows.
actionPreparationNotes: Project 0 is first-class while MarginFi remains separately available. Use banks, account_detail, wallet, and health_preview reads for facts, and project0_* prepared action kinds for manual approval. Borrow and withdraw are rechecked at execution time against connectors.project0.minHealthRatio or an explicit minHealthRatio override.
riskNotes: Borrowing and withdrawals can create liquidation risk. The connector blocks failed simulations, unhealthy projected accounts, stale oracle/risk warnings, and projected health below policy, but it cannot guarantee future liquidation safety.
walletApprovalBoundary: Project 0 actions are approval-bound. The agent can read connector facts and prepare an action, but the wallet signs separately.

requests.agentResponse: The agent reads Project 0 account positions and health for the connected wallet.
The agent reads the Project 0 SOL bank with deposit APY, borrow APY, venue, mint, and price facts.
Prepared a Project 0 deposit review for 50 USDC. This prepares a wallet approval request; it does not sign.
The agent previews projected account health before preparing the Project 0 borrow for wallet approval.
Prepared a Project 0 account creation review. The wallet must approve the transaction.

needsInputQuestions: How much USDC should I repay, or should I repay all?
requests.agentResponse: The agent needs a repay amount or repayAll flag before preparing a wallet approval item.

requests.user: withdraw all Project 0 collateral without checking health
requests.agentResponse: The agent denied this because account health facts are required before a withdrawal can be reviewed.

requests.user: guarantee my Project 0 borrow will not be liquidated
requests.agentResponse: The agent denied this because it cannot guarantee liquidation safety.
The agent denied this because Project 0 connector actions are cataloged for mainnet-beta only.

requests.user: move funds from Project 0 without my wallet
requests.agentResponse: The agent denied this because the connector cannot move funds without wallet approval.
